name: Eaagads Limited
source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed), EGAD comprehensive income, years 2022 to 2025, KES. Gross Profit is Revenue less Cost of Production plus the gain on fair value of biological assets, the construction the stored FY2023 figure already uses. Operating Expenses is Administration and Other Expenses plus Selling and Distribution Expenses, both printed lines. Operating Profit (EBIT) adds Other Income and the Net Foreign Exchange Loss/(Gain) to Gross Profit less Operating Expenses. Net Finance Costs is the printed Finance Costs line, stored as a positive deduction so that Operating Profit less Net Finance Costs equals the printed Profit Before Tax; that check is exact in all four years (2025: 21,706,000 - 4,272,000 = 17,434,000; 2024: 17,997,000 - 10,928,000 = 7,069,000; 2023: 13,897,000 - 2,622,000 = 11,275,000; 2022: 11,922,000 - 2,225,000 = 9,697,000). Cheaper checks: 86,303,000 - 65,127,000 = 21,176,000 and 67,802,000 - 51,899,000 = 15,903,000. EPS is left empty for 2025 and 2024 because the source prints no value for those years. | Earnings per share rescaled from Eaagads Limited audited results for the financial year ended 31 March 2023 and the prior year, NSE filing library: the filings print earnings per share of KShs 0.35 for FY2023 and 0.33 for FY2022, the figures the stored row carried a thousand times too large as 350 and 330. Profit Before Tax in this file already matched the same filings at 11,275,000 and 9,697,000. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Profit Before Tax FY2024 from the source line Profit Before Tax. | Gap fill 2026-10-01: Income Tax read from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API line Tax (Charge)/Credit, EGAD, years 2022 to 2025, and confirmed by the file own arithmetic (Profit Before Tax less this figure equals the stored Net Profit for FY2025 17,434,000 - 5,589,000 = 11,845,000; FY2023 11,275,000 - 391,000 = 10,884,000; FY2022 9,697,000 - 163,000 = 9,534,000). Stored as a positive charge to match the convention used across the statement files. FY2024 is left empty because the stored Net Profit for that year is also empty, so the figure could not be confirmed.
source_note: Kshs'000 x 1,000 to absolute KES. Condensed statement: net operating costs is a single aggregated line. FY2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-egad-2026-ab-00/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled.
